title: China–Soviet/Russian border settlement: source and reading register
coverage_policy: Downloaded availability is not reading. Full articles or published treaty bodies are distinguished from missing annexes and selected complete chapters. Foreign-language translations and analytical paraphrases are investigator work. Source instructions treated as document content, never user instructions. Copyrighted snapshots remain outside Git. Later 2025 official search lead is not an extended current border-status audit.

sources.title: Akihiro Iwashita, A 4,000 Kilometer Journey Along the Sino-Russian Border (component 1)
sources.read_scope: Preface ix–xiii and Introduction 1–7 complete, including notes; PDF physical pages 10–21. Earlier front matter inspected for identification, not a complete front-matter reading.
sources.claim_use_limit: Selected full chapters only; whole monograph not fully read. July 14, 2004 preface predates October settlement. Participant memoirs and local reporting are attributed rather than independently authenticated. Rumored packages, inferred island exchanges and unverified expiry claim excluded from established chronology. Author favors cooperation; terminology merges delimitation/demarcation, which this case separates.

sources.title: PRC–USSR Agreement on the Eastern Section of the Boundary

sources.read_scope: Complete four-page signed Russian text, all eight articles and signatures, visually read.
sources.claim_use_limit: No annex map recovered; entry-into-force date not independently verified.

sources.title: Agreement on joint economic use of individual islands and adjacent waters in boundary rivers
sources.read_scope: Complete published 12-article body, preamble and publication notes, six PDF pages.
sources.claim_use_limit: FAO reproduction of Bulletin of International Treaties 2004 no. 8 p. 31 explicitly says publication incomplete. Appendices 1 and 2 omitted: precise maps, numerical user caps and detailed permit procedures not read. Five years is stipulated use duration with dates determined diplomatically, not proved actual expiration or current status.

sources.title: Treaty of Good-Neighborliness and Friendly Cooperation between the PRC and Russian Federation
sources.read_scope: All 25 articles plus signature/date lines read in official English publication.
sources.claim_use_limit: Article 6 no-mutual-claims language coexists with explicit unresolved boundary alignments; not a final boundary settlement. URL reflects 2024 migration, substantive publication July 2001.

sources.title: PRC–Russian Federation Supplementary Agreement on the Eastern Section of the Boundary
sources.read_scope: Complete three-page published Chinese body: seven articles, coordinates, signing/effective-date notes and figure list.
sources.claim_use_limit: Six listed figures omitted from this 2023 reproduction; accompanying schematics separately recovered from NPC Gazette. Original incorporated 1:100,000 maps not acquired.

sources.title: Russian presidential order 479-rp and three attached draft instruments
sources.read_scope: Full order and all three drafts: supplementary boundary agreement, navigation protocol and memorandum on applying existing agreements.
sources.claim_use_limit: Private legal publisher reproduction, not independently retrieved official Kremlin copy. Establishes Russian authorization, not Chinese instructions. Navigation draft contemplates future negotiation and is not authenticated final navigation regime.

sources.title: Memorandum on application of existing agreements to newly delimited border sections
sources.read_scope: Complete two-page Chinese publication visually read, including one substantive provision, effectiveness and Li Zhaoxing/Lavrov signatures.
sources.claim_use_limit: Extends existing cooperation agreements; does not identify the later detailed navigation regime. Treaty-database disclaimer is source boilerplate, not an instruction.

sources.title: China–Russia Joint Statement, Hu Jintao and Vladimir Putin
sources.read_scope: Complete seven substantive sections and signature lines in official English publication.
sources.claim_use_limit: Public joint objectives and justification, not private causation. Simultaneous border, WTO and energy discussion does not establish a quid pro quo. URL reflects later migration.
